lines.text: &fThis is your page. It gathers what the server knows about you in one place, so you do not have to go looking for any of it.
&e&lYour figure
&7On the left is you, wearing exactly what you are wearing right now. Change armour or swap what is in your hand and it updates immediately.
&e&lRank
&7Your standing on the server. Ranks come from staff, and some of them raise limits elsewhere &8- a prime rank allows more warps and more homes than the default.
&e&lStarcoins

&7The server currency. You earn it from daily tasks, quest rewards, time played and by selling to other players through the Auction House or a vending block. You spend it on plots, on paid warps, and on anything another player is selling.
&7Large balances are shortened &8(1.5K)&7; the money history shows exact amounts.
&e&lQuests
&7How far through the quest book you are. The number counts required quests only &8- hover the line to see how many optional ones you have also finished.
&e&lTier
&7Your progression tier, which rises as you complete quests. Tiers gate parts of the pack, so this is the number to watch if something is not available to you yet.
&e&lWarnings

&7How many warnings you have, and the number from which each one bans you. Warnings &cnever expire&7: the third, and every one after it, bans you for a day. If you are muted, how long is left shows here too.
&7When letters are waiting for you, a &6gold line&7 below says how many are unread.
&e&lKits

&7The column on the right lists the kits you may take. Press &fTake&7 and the items go into your inventory &8- whatever does not fit drops at your feet&7. The button then counts down until the kit is ready again. Hover a kit to see how many items it holds.
&e&lMoney history

&7The clock button at the top opens every movement of your Starcoins: the amount, what it was for, the item and the other player where there was one, and how long ago. The drop-down narrows it to &fSales&7, &fPurchases&7, &fVending blocks&7, &fAuction house&7 or &fRewards&7.
&8Every figure here updates while the hub is open. Nothing needs reopening.
